title: Update linear-status.md — Epics 25-27 marked 'all Backlog' despite dozens of implemented, non-skipped story-acceptance tests

evidence.quote: 35 stories. Eight feature areas reorganized to consume the new core.
17 stories (16 Backlog, 1 Canceled). Test pyramid, CI gates, observability, docs.

why: linear-status.md (self-dated 'last reconciled 2026-05-13', ~7 weeks stale relative to the audit date) states all of Epic 25 (22 stories), Epic 26 (35 stories) and Epic 27 (17 stories) are 'Backlog'. But test/story_acceptance/ already contains 31 distinct epic_25/26/27 story-numbered test files (e.g. epic_25_story_25_20_locale_theme_test.dart, epic_26_story_26_7_dashboard_model_provider_test.dart, epic_27_story_14_analytics_test.dart) totaling well over 150 test groups with a single `skip:` marker among them — i.e. these are live, executing acceptance suites, not scaffolded placeholders. Anyone using this doc to plan work risks re-scoping or re-implementing stories that already shipped.
recommendation: Re-sync against status/sprint-status.yaml (the doc's own stated source of truth) and, as a cheap proxy check going forward, cross-reference `grep -L 'skip:' test/story_acceptance/epic_2[567]_*.dart` against the Backlog list before publishing a status doc.
acceptance_criteria: Epic 25/26/27 story statuses in linear-status.md match sprint-status.yaml
no story shown 'Backlog' has a fully un-skipped acceptance test file in test/story_acceptance/
